title: Voice input
sharedExplanation: Used whenever you chat as any persona. Voice input is shared across all your personas — not configured per-persona.
offHint: Voice input is off. Select or create an STT configuration to enable it.
preSyncTitle: Voice input isn't set up yet
preSyncHint: Connect to Harmony Link to configure voice input — it will become available to all personas once the engine is connected.
liveTestHint: Streams live audio while the engine listens and transcribes (uses the engine's VAD segmentation).
quickTestHint: Records one utterance, then transcribes it — handy when no VAD is configured or for a single phrase.
noVadSegments: This provider doesn't report VAD segments.
offlineTitle: Connect to Harmony Link to test
offlineHint: The test panel runs the engine's configured STT provider. Connect to Harmony Link to try it.
usesSavedConfig: Tests your saved voice input configuration (unsaved draft changes aren't applied).
permissionDenied: Microphone permission is required to record.
